title: MLM Network Development Specialist
description:
About Bees Mobile



Bees Mobile is a digital telecommunications company offering global connectivity solutions, including US/HK virtual phone numbers and international travel eSIM services.



As we expand into the Philippines, we are looking for experienced network builders to help us grow our local partner network.



Role Overview



We are looking for a proactive and well-connected individual with proven experience in MLM, direct sales, and building their own teams.



Your main responsibility will be to actively recruit potential team leaders, MLM professionals, and direct sellers who can build and expand their own networks within Bees Mobile.



We are looking for a natural networker who knows how to connect with people, identify potential leaders, present business opportunities, and develop teams.



Key Responsibilities



Actively network and recruit experienced MLM professionals, direct sellers, and potential team leaders.



Identify individuals with strong personal networks and the ability to build their own teams.



Present the Bees Mobile business opportunity to potential partners.



Build and maintain relationships with recruited partners and support their team development.



Explore online and offline networking opportunities to expand the Philippine market.



Work toward agreed recruitment and team development targets.



Qualifications



Proven experience in MLM (Multi-Level Marketing) and direct selling.



Previous experience building and managing your own team or distributor network.



Strong networking, recruitment, and relationship-building skills.



Ability to independently approach and recruit potential partners.



Good communication skills in English and Tagalog.



Existing connections within MLM or direct-selling communities in the Philippines are a strong advantage.



Compensation & Working Arrangement



Monthly Base Payment: USD $200.



Additional performance-based bonuses on top of the base payment. Bonus structures and targets will be discussed separately.



Flexible schedule – not a full-time position.



Fully remote.



Target-oriented, with a focus on recruitment and network growth.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Introduction Video: Briefly introduce yourself and explain your MLM/direct sales experience, the teams you have built, and your recruitment experience.



Updated Resume/CV: Include your previous experience in MLM, direct sales, and team management.

title: NOW HIRING — SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATOR & GROWTH MANAGER | Moodap + The NYC Classifieds
description:
# NOW HIRING — SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT CREATOR & GROWTH MANAGER

**Remote | Full-Time | Multiple Brands**



We are hiring a highly creative, experienced social media professional to manage and grow multiple emerging digital brands.



We're starting with two NYC-focused platforms:



**The NYC Classifieds** — 
  

A free, verified local marketplace connecting New Yorkers, local businesses, and service professionals.



**Moodap** — 
  

An NYC discovery platform helping people find restaurants, nightlife, experiences, and places to explore.



This is **not simply a social media posting job**.



We need someone who can take complete ownership of social media strategy, content production, publishing, community engagement, and organic audience growth.



## Your Responsibilities



**1. Develop the strategy**



- Create a separate social media growth strategy for each brand.

- Understand each platform's target audience and unique positioning.

- Identify trends, content opportunities, and effective distribution channels.

- Build and execute weekly content plans.

- Continuously improve performance based on results.



**2. Create all content**



- Write compelling posts, captions, hooks, and calls to action.

- Design professional graphics, images, and carousels.

- Create short-form videos, Reels, TikToks, and promotional clips.

- Edit video with engaging pacing, captions, and appropriate audio.

- Use AI tools, Canva, CapCut, and other creative software to produce high-quality content.

- Maintain consistent branding and visual quality.



**3. Publish and manage social accounts**



Manage relevant platforms, including Instagram, TikTok,
, YouTube Shorts, and other channels where the target audience is active.



- Publish consistently.

- Adapt content for each platform.

- Monitor comments and messages.

- Respond to users professionally.

- Maintain an active and engaging presence.



**4. Grow followers and engagement**



Your job isn't finished when a post goes live.



We expect you to:



- Actively grow genuine, relevant followers.

- Generate comments, shares, saves, and conversations.

- Participate in relevant NYC communities without spamming.

- Identify collaboration opportunities.

- Engage with local businesses, creators, and community accounts.

- Turn social attention into website visitors, registrations, and active users.



**5. Measure results and improve**



Track meaningful performance:



- Follower growth

- Reach and engagement

- Video views and watch time

- Profile visits

- Website traffic from social media

- Registrations and verified signups

- Best-performing content

- Community interactions



Provide a concise weekly performance report with results and next steps.



## What We're Looking For



- **3+ years of hands-on social media management and content creation experience.**

- Proven ability to grow accounts organically.

- Strong graphic design and short-form video editing skills.

- Excellent written English.

- Experience with Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Comfortable using AI creative tools.

- Strong understanding of trends and audience behavior.

- Independent, proactive, organized, and fast-moving.

- Ability to manage multiple brands without mixing their identities.

- A portfolio showing content you personally created and accounts you helped grow.



**We want a creator who thinks like a growth marketer—not someone who spends all day building calendars and spreadsheets.**



## First 30 Days



You will:



- Develop and launch distinct content strategies for both brands.

- Establish a consistent posting schedule.

- Produce original graphics and short-form videos.

- Publish content and actively engage with the audience.

- Test different creative formats and messaging.

- Identify what generates genuine followers, engagement, and website visits.

- Work with each brand's lead administrator to convert social interest into active users.



Our goal is to build **real audiences, not inflated follower counts**.



## How to Apply



Send a **3–5 minute video introduction** explaining:



1. Which social media accounts have you personally grown, and what measurable results did you achieve?

2. Show us examples of graphics and videos you created yourself.

3. What would your first seven days of social media strategy look like for The NYC Classifieds and Moodap?



Include links to your portfolio and examples of your best work.



We're looking for someone who can **start quickly, take ownership, create excellent content, and produce measurable growth.**



**Two brands to start. Many more opportunities ahead.**

description:
Location: Manila or Clark, Philippines  

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote  

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM

About the Role



We are looking for a Semi-Senior Audit to join our team and handle audit engagements for Singapore-based companies across various industries.



This role is suitable for someone with at least 3 years of external audit experience who can manage audit assignments independently, coordinate with clients and overseas teams, and guide junior associates.



You will gain exposure to Singapore audit practices, financial reporting, consolidation, tax computation and group reporting while working closely with Audit Supervisors and Partners.

Key Responsibilities



1. Handle audit engagements for Singapore companies across various industries.

2. Perform audit planning, control testing, analytical procedures and substantive testing of details.

3. Prepare and review audit working papers, ensuring that the purpose, procedures performed and conclusions are clearly documented.

What We're Looking For



1. Degree in Accounting, ACCA or another relevant accounting qualification.

2. At least 3 years of external audit experience.

3. Strong understanding of audit procedures, accounting principles and Singapore Financial Reporting Standards.

4. Experience in managing audit assignments and coordinating with clients.

5. Experience in financial statement preparation, consolidation, tax computation and group reporting is an advantage.

7. Proactive, responsible and able to maintain good client relationships.

Why Join Us?

3. Opportunities to lead audit assignments and coordinate with overseas teams.

4. Broader exposure to financial reporting, consolidation, tax computation and group reporting.

title: Telegram Sales Admin – Forex Trading (Remote)
description:
Telegram Sales Admin – Forex Trading (Remote) 



Full-Time | 8-Hour Graveyard Shift | $700/Month Base + $12 Per Conversion + Performance Bonuses 



ABOUT US



We run a large Gold trading community, and are looking for a full-time remote sales admin to help convert incoming leads into members of our private signals group. We provide all the leads, so you don't need to do any outreach. The leads are warm, they already know us and are interested in joining, your job is simply to close them. 



This is a sales role, not customer support. All sales happen through
 messages, with no phone calls or video calls required.



IMPORTANT: This is a graveyard shift, 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippines Time (PHT / GMT+8), Monday to Friday. You must be fully active during these hours. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this schedule.



HOW THE BUSINESS WORKS



People interested in joining our private trading signals group must register with our affiliated broker and fund their account. Your job is to convert these interested leads by guiding them through broker registration, deposits and activation, while handling objections and following up. We have complete SOPs and message templates for you to follow.



You'll earn $12 for every successful conversion on top of your $700 fixed monthly salary, plus additional bonuses for reaching sales milestones.



ROLE DETAILS



- Position:
 Sales Admin

- Location: Fully remote, full-time

- Schedule: Monday to Friday, Graveyard shift 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (Philippines Time)

- Expectation: Fully active and responsive during working hours



COMPENSATION



- $700 USD base monthly salary

- $12 commission for every successful conversion (uncapped)

- Additional bonuses for reaching sales milestones



Example: 100 successful conversions in a month = $1,200 commission + $700 fixed salary = $1,900 total monthly earnings.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Handle 60 to 100 warm-lead conversations per day on

- Convert interested leads into broker registrations and first-time deposits (FTDs)

- Guide clients through KYC, broker registration, deposits and onboarding

- Follow up with leads who go quiet

- Handle objections ("I only have 100 dollars", "let me think about it")

- Follow our messaging SOPs and track the leads



REQUIREMENTS



- MUST HAVE: previous experience in chat support, appointment setting, chat sales, CRM, or a similar high-volume texting role

- Strong and reliable internet connection

- Basic knowledge of forex trading or other financial markets. 

- Fluent written English

- Able to communicate naturally and confidently through text, without sounding robotic or overly scripted

- Full availability during the assigned working hours

- Able to manage multiple conversations at once



Bonus: previous experience in the forex or trading industry



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. Shift confirmation: confirm you can work Monday to Friday, Graveyard shift 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM (Philippines Time) and be fully active during that time.

2. Availability confirmation: confirm you won't be working another job during your shift.

3. Your relevant experience: briefly describe your most relevant experience, how familiar you are with trading, and why you're a good fit for this role.



Applications missing any of these three will not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will read our SOP, do an interview test, then complete a 3-day paid trial handling simulated messages before being hired full-time.

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo email/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end email & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted email & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

title: Cold-Calling Appointment Setter, US Hours (B2B SaaS, long-term)
description:
Please read this first. The shift is 12 noon to 8pm US Eastern. That is 1am to 9am in the Philippines. If that doesn't work, this isn't the job. If you've worked US hours before, we want to hear from you.



We're CustomGPT.ai, a Boston company. We build an AI assistant for membership associations (bar associations, medical societies, trade groups). We're adding a caller to our team.



THE JOB

- Call CEOs and executive directors of associations. Book a 30-minute intro with our platform expert.

- High volume:
dials a day on a prepared list through our dialer. You don't build lists.

- These are first calls to strangers. Not callbacks, not reminders, not warm leads.

- Log every call in our CRM. Get past gatekeepers honestly. No tricks.

- Same day: send the invite and a short recap.

- A weekly review of your numbers and recorded calls.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

- Made 100+ cold dials a day in a real job and can prove it. If your past roles were 30-50 dials a day, this will feel very different.

- Cold-called senior decision makers (CEOs, executive directors, owners, VPs). You can name the exact titles and what you sold.

- Have 12+ months of outbound B2B phone work with one employer or client.

- Know your own numbers and can give a reference.

- Sound like a person on the phone, not someone reading.

- Have worked nights before, with a headset, a quiet room and backup internet.



NOT A FIT

- Appointment-reminder, service-scheduling or callback calling as your main phone work (for example car dealership service lines, clinics, utilities)

-
-only or chat-only experience

- Consumer sales as your whole background

- Agencies or teams. We hire one person

- Anyone who uses a script reader, a voice changer or an AI voice



PAY AND PROCESS

- $10-$14 an hour, plus $75 for each qualified meeting that takes place. Paid weekly.

- Rate review every 3 months, up to $15/hr.

- Every hour of training and trial is paid.

- How we hire: (1) answer the 6 questions and record the voice sample, (2) the best few do a paid 2-day cold-calling test on a real list, (3) a 15-minute video call and a reference check, (4) a paid one-week trial, then a contract.

- We check what you tell us. We record the test calls, with your clear yes first.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with: "I read the hours: 1am-9am PH."

2. Answer the 6 questions below.

3. Record the voice sample below and paste the link. One take, no editing.



THE 6 QUESTIONS

1. Last outbound phone job: employer, what they sold, the exact job titles you called most, start and end dates (month and year), why it ended.

2. Your numbers, best three months: dials per day, live conversations per day, meetings booked per month, and how many took place. How did the company count a meeting?

3. Cold or warm? Was your first call to a stranger who had never heard of the company? Or were you calling existing customers, inbound leads or booked appointments? Where did the list come from?

4. Night shift: have you worked US hours before? How long? How do you manage sleep and your setup? What headset and backup internet do you have?

5. Who can we contact to confirm? Name, title, company, and how they would describe your results.

6. Your rate within $10-$14/hr, and why.



THE VOICE SAMPLE

Record one voice message, 60 to 90 seconds. One take. No editing, no music, no reading from a script. Use a headset or your phone close to your mouth, in a quiet room. Record it on 
 and paste the link.

The scene: you are cold-calling Jordan Blake, Executive Director of a professional association. A gatekeeper answers first and asks "What's this regarding?"

1. Get past the gatekeeper, honestly.

2. Pitch Jordan a 30-minute intro meeting about an AI assistant that answers members' questions from the association's own content.

3. Handle one objection: "We already have a website search."

4. Close on a specific day and time.

Play both sides, or leave silent pauses where they would reply. Your choice. Do not read.

what you get

- real ownership and a direct line to the founder

title: Real Estate Data Manager (YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH)
description:
* YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH *

We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling.



The work is consistent, structured, and rewards accuracy. If you're the kind of person who notices a misspelled column header and fixes it without being asked — keep reading.



This is a long-term role. We want someone who will own this pipeline for years, not weeks.





Schedule

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Days: Monday through Friday

- Time zone: 9am-6pm (CST)

- Deadline: All daily lists must be live in our CRM daily.



Pay

- $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly via Payoneer or PayPal

- Performance bonus for clean data quality and on-time delivery

- Raise review at 90 days



What You'll Do Every Day:

1. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction.

2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM.

3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format

4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing

5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status)

6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1

7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage

8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.)



A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch.



Tools You'll Use:

- Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP)

- FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you)

- XLeads (skip tracing)

- Trestle (phone verification)

- County government websites (varies by list type)

- Slack (daily check-ins and questions)



What We Need From You:

- Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting

- Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money

- Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace

- Good written English for daily Slack updates

- Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team)

- Able to start As Soon As Possible



Bonus Points If You Have:

- Prior US real estate experience

- Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM

- Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles

- Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.)

- Familiarity with US county records systems



What Makes This Role Different:

- Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week.

- Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday.

- Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role.

You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach.



How to Apply

1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread.

2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took.

3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time.

4. Tell me your minimum acceptable hourly rate in USD.

5. Confirm you have a stable internet and a quiet workspace.



We will respond to the strongest applicants within 3 business days.



Thank you for reading the full post. We're looking forward to building a long-term team with the right person.

title: YouTube Channel Manager & Content Producer
description:
We’re looking for someone to help manage, organize, and grow a starting YouTube channel.



You’ll take ownership of the content process-- from organizing footage and reviewing edits to publishing and improving channel performance. As the channel grows, we’d like this person to become more involved in content ideas, planning, and larger productions.

---





WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Coordinate with video editors and keep projects moving

BONUS TO HAVE

title: Amazon Brand Manager
description:
[READ EVERYTHING PROPERLY BEFORE APPLYING]

[Do not apply if you do not fit the requirements]

[Do not apply if you dislike time trackers]

--



JOB SUMMARY:

As our Amazon Brand Manager, you'll be the one steering how our products perform on Amazon day to day — from pricing and promotions to ad campaigns and everything in between. You'll keep an eye on our listings, spot opportunities to grow revenue, and help us stay ahead in our category.





RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Manage daily sales operations for assigned products, including pricing, promotions, and advertising campaigns

- Oversee product listings and identify new revenue opportunities within respective categories

- Monitor product performance to drive consistent sales growth and stronger category rankings

- Conduct in-depth product analysis and research market trends/competitors to guide strategic decisions

- Collaborate with the inventory planning team to manage promotions and excess inventory

- Ensure accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality across all deliverables





QUALIFICATIONS:

• Strong brand management experience — from listing optimization and A+ Content to product launches and brand positioning

• PPC experience is a plus, but not required

• Strong analytical, data-driven decision-making skills

• Solid market research experience

• Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Strong documentation and time management skills

• High preference: applicants within NCR or nearby areas (e.g., Bulacan, Rizal).





NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS:

• You'll need to send a portfolio with a real ASIN you've personally handled from launch to finish (brand/product can be blurred), backed by substantial data — think sales or bestseller ranking graphs, not just a screenshot. If NDA-restricted or you no longer have account access, a short video walkthrough explaining the work and results is acceptable instead.

• Be ready to walk through and explain the actual performance data behind that ASIN during the interview — conversion rate, ACOS, organic vs. paid sales split. This will be a substantial part of the conversation, so come prepared to speak to real numbers, not general claims.





SETUP:

• Full-time, 9AM to 6PM PHT

• Uses Time Doctor for time tracking

• Own equipment needed (Laptop, Mouse, Earphones/Headphones)

• Stable internet connection, with a readily available backup connection

• Full-time contractual employment (renewal contract based on performance)

• There will be quarterly (with chances of it being monthly) meet-ups within NCR whenever the CEO visits the Philippines

title: Youtube (Vlogs) Video Editor
description:
We’re looking for a Video Editor with experience creating engaging YouTube and vlog-style content.



This role is best suited for someone who knows how to turn raw footage into a clear and enjoyable story, especially for travel, lifestyle, personality-led, and long-form YouTube content. Experience focused only on short-form reels, ads, corporate videos, or highly effects-driven editing may not be the best fit for this role.

---





WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Review raw footage and choose the best moments for each video

- Turn footage into clear, engaging YouTube vlog stories

- Create strong intros, smooth pacing, and endings that keep viewers interested

- Cut filler, repetition, and unnecessary footage

- Add subtitles, on-screen text, music, and sound effects

- Improve audio quality and keep voices clear and consistent

- Apply color correction and grading

- Use B-roll, transitions, zooms, graphics, and effects where appropriate

- Organize footage and project files properly

- Handle revisions and feedback efficiently

- Prepare polished 16:9 videos ready for YouTube





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- Experience editing YouTube videos, vlogs, travel, lifestyle, or personality-led content

- Strong sense of storytelling and pacing

- Able to identify which moments are worth keeping and which should be cut

- Good attention to audio, subtitles, timing, and visual consistency

- Comfortable editing phone-recorded and mixed-quality footage

- Comfortable working with CapCut, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, and other relevant editing tools

- Experience with motion graphics or more advanced editing is a plus

- Open to feedback and able to deliver polished work with minimal revisions

- Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented

- Able to handle private footage professionally and confidentially





WORK SETUP



- Full-time contractual role

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine Time

- Time tracker required

- No moonlighting or outside full-time employment





HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you’ve read the full job post, please type "HELLO YOUTUBE" as the very first sentence of your application.



After that, please provide:



1. Your CV link

2. Your portfolio link showing your best YouTube or vlog editing work

3. A short text introduction about your relevant video editing experience. Please keep it focused on experience related to this role.

4. Your expected monthly salary in USD, not hourly

title: Recruitment & HR Specialist – Philippines
description:
About Bees Mobile



Bees Mobile is a fast-growing digital telecommunications company offering global connectivity solutions, including US/HK virtual phone numbers and international travel eSIM services.



As we expand into the Philippines, we are building a local Business Development (BD) team and looking for an experienced recruiter who understands MLM and network marketing.



Role Overview



We are looking for a proactive Recruitment & HR Specialist with experience in MLM, direct sales, and team building.



Your main responsibility will be to identify, recruit, and onboard qualified Business Development Managers (BDs) who can help expand Bees Mobile's network in the Philippines.



We need someone who understands how MLM organizations operate, knows where to find experienced network marketers, and can identify individuals with strong leadership and recruitment abilities.



Key Responsibilities



Actively source and recruit experienced MLM professionals, direct sales representatives, and potential BD Managers.



Identify candidates with proven experience building and managing their own teams.



Conduct initial interviews and evaluate candidates' recruitment, networking, and leadership experience.



Present the Bees Mobile business opportunity to potential BD candidates.



Manage the recruitment process, candidate follow-ups, and onboarding.



Help build and expand a network of qualified BD Managers across the Philippines.



Track recruitment progress and work toward agreed hiring targets.



Qualifications



Previous experience in MLM, network marketing, or direct sales recruitment.



Experience recruiting team leaders, distributors, or sales managers.



Strong understanding of MLM structures and team-building strategies.



Excellent networking, communication, and interviewing skills.



Ability to independently source and approach qualified candidates.



Good command of English and Tagalog.



Existing connections within Philippine MLM and direct-selling communities are a strong advantage.



Compensation & Working Arrangement



Monthly Base Payment: USD $200.



Additional performance-based bonuses on top of the base payment. Bonus structures and targets will be discussed separately.



Flexible schedule – not a full-time position.



Fully remote.



Target-oriented, with a focus on successful BD recruitment.



How to Apply



Please submit:



Updated Resume/CV: Include relevant recruitment, HR, MLM, and team-building experience.

title: B2B / B2C - Outbound Appointment Setter
description:
We are looking for an experienced, proactive, and results-driven Outbound Appointment Setter to support a U.S.-based marketing agency that provides digital marketing services and marketing solutions for print shop owners.



The main focus of this role is to identify potential customers, reach out through cold
s, LinkedIn, and phone calls, and schedule qualified appointments for the business owner. You will be responsible for managing daily outreach activities, following up with interested prospects, and keeping the CRM updated.



This is not a sales closing position. Your primary responsibility is to generate qualified leads and book appointments. The business owner will handle all sales calls and closing.



We are looking for someone who already has experience in B2B outreach, can communicate confidently with business owners, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



SHIFT

Must be available to work in the U.S. Mountain Time business hours.





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Lead Generation and Prospect Research

- Research and build targeted lists of business owners and general managers.

- Find and verify approximately 70–80 new prospects per day, targeting around 350 per week.

- Use Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar prospecting tools.

- Verify
 addresses before adding prospects to outreach campaigns.

- Identify relevant reasons for reaching out to each prospect.



2. Cold
 Outreach

- Set up and manage multi-step cold
 campaigns using Instantly, Smartlead, or similar tools.

- Upload prospect lists into
 outreach platforms.

- Monitor
 deliverability, bounce rates, and campaign performance.

- Understand basic
 authentication, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and mailbox warm-up.

- Report deliverability issues and pause mailboxes when bounce rates exceed 3%.



3. LinkedIn Outreach

- Send approximately 15–20 targeted LinkedIn connection requests daily.

- Send professional follow-up messages to potential customers.

-Track responses and identify interested prospects.



4. Cold Calling and Appointment Setting

- Make approximately 20 cold calls daily to prospects who have engaged but have not responded.

- Communicate professionally and confidently with business owners.

- Respond to prospect inquiries within 2 hours during working hours.

- Qualify interested prospects and schedule appointments on the business owner's calendar.

- Provide a brief summary of each scheduled appointment.



5. CRM Management and Reporting

- Record all outreach activities, responses, and appointment details in GoHighLevel (GHL).

- Keep prospect records organized and updated.

- Send daily updates on completed activities and results.

- Prepare a weekly performance report covering prospects contacted,
 bounce rates, positive responses, appointments booked, and calls completed.



QUALIFICATIONS

- At least 1 year of proven experience in B2B outbound sales, appointment setting, cold
 outreach, or sales development.

- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

- Experience using Instantly, Smartlead, or similar cold
 platforms.

- Experience using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar prospecting tools.

- Knowledge of
 verification and deliverability best practices.

- Comfortable making outbound calls to U.S.-based business owners.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage daily outreach targets and work independently.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace suitable for phone calls.



 Preferred but Not Required:

- Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM systems.

- Background in digital marketing, printing, signage, or marketing services.

- Experience creating or improving cold
 copy.



If you believe you're a good fit for this position, please submit the following:

- Your updated resume in PDF format.

- A screenshot of your computer specifications and internet speed.

- Your WhatsApp number for communication.



Please use "Appointment Setting" as the subject line of your application.



We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Video Editor for AI Real Estate Videos | Full-Time, U.S. Company ($800–$2,000/mo)
description:
We're AiVideos.co, a U.S. studio that makes AI-generated commercials and short-form videos, a lot of it for real estate agents, title companies and mortgage pros. AI makes the footage. You make it feel like a real commercial.



This is a full-time, permanent role editing our videos every day.



What you'll do:

- Cut AI-generated clips into finished vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) videos

- Add clean captions, motion text and name labels

- Hide AI glitches in the edit (hands, faces, warping, text)

- Match color and audio, add music and sound

- Deliver on time, every time



What we're looking for:

- Real estate videos in your portfolio (listing reels, agent promos, property tours) are a big plus

- Short-form vertical editing with captions and motion graphics

- Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, After Effects a plus

- Experience with AI video (Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, Veo) is a plus

- At least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern time each workday

- Clear written English



What you get:

- $800 to $2,000 USD per month, based on experience

- 40 hours a week, permanent, fully remote

- Steady work, no gaps between projects



How to apply:

Fill out our 60-second application. It's just links to work you've already done, no test: 

Put your most relevant piece first (real estate if you have it), and in the rate box put your expected monthly rate.



Prefer to apply here on OnlineJobs.ph? That works too, just include the same two links.



No unpaid tests. If your work is a fit, we'll set up a short video call.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours 



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision: 

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business. 



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us! 



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager 



Role Purpose 

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time. 



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events. 



What Success Looks Like 

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance. 



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts. 



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution. 



Primary Objectives 

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System 

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR 

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment 

Competitive Advantage 

 

Regular Work Activities 

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails) 

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking 

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy 

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates 

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track) 

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content) 

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs 

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates 

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates 

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals 

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP) 

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration 

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR 

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required 

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals) 

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement 

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets) 

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing) 

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type) 

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed 

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list) 

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches) 

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues) 

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers) 

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination) 

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests) 



Key Skills 

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth) 

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions) 

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation 

Organized project management across many ASINs 

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating) 

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes 

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops) 

 

People Contacts and Interactions 

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment) 

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes) 

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions) 

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment 



Role Requirements 

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred) 

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent) 

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents) 

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work 

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline 

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back 



How to Apply:

Click the link - 

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

description:
ABOUT KIPKEH MEDIA



Kipkeh Media is a growing US-based digital media network and communication brand serving the Orthodox Jewish community. We create and publish daily video stories, promotional materials, graphics, and community-focused content through a fast-paced, time-sensitive publishing operation.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented, and proactive Operations & Media Specialist to support our daily production activities, manage administrative workflows, coordinate with clients and vendors, and ensure that important tasks are completed accurately and on schedule.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in a structured environment, takes pride in staying organized, and can independently manage responsibilities without needing constant supervision.



We value people who think ahead, communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and understand the importance of consistency in a growing operation.



THE WORKING ENVIRONMENT



Our operation follows established workflows, daily publishing schedules, and clearly defined responsibilities. Since many of our activities are time-sensitive, we need someone who can manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and reliability.



We encourage team members to take initiative, raise concerns early, and suggest better ways of handling daily tasks.



You will be given processes, expectations, and the necessary tools to perform your responsibilities. In return, we expect you to manage your workload responsibly, maintain regular communication, and follow through on commitments.



This is a full-time position intended for someone who can give their working hours consistent attention and build a long-term working relationship with the company.



2-WEEK PAID TRIAL PERIOD



All new team members begin with a 2-week paid evaluation period at the agreed hourly rate of $4.00–$5.00 USD, based on experience, for 40 hours per week.



The purpose of this period is to understand your working style, evaluate your ability to handle actual responsibilities, and ensure that the position is a good fit for both parties.



During the trial, we will assess:



Initiative & Ownership:Your ability to manage assigned responsibilities, anticipate upcoming tasks, ask questions when necessary, and follow through without repeated reminders.



Reliability & Communication: Consistent attendance, punctuality, responsiveness on Slack, and proper communication during shift transitions.



Organization & Tracking:Your ability to maintain accurate Google Sheets, update task statuses, organize files, and keep relevant records current.



Work Quality & Efficiency: Your ability to prepare content, perform basic video edits, and complete daily assignments accurately within the required timelines.



Candidates who successfully complete the evaluation period will transition into an ongoing, long-term full-time position.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



WhatsApp Status Content Preparation & Scheduling: Organize, prepare, and schedule daily WhatsApp Status videos and graphics. Verify content sequencing, branding, and publishing schedules to ensure materials are ready within designated posting windows.



Basic Video Editing & Quality Control: Use CapCut to trim raw footage, remove unnecessary pauses, adjust video formats, and apply approved logos, introductions, and watermarks using existing templates. Advanced video editing skills are not required; accuracy, consistency, and efficiency are the priorities.



Client & Vendor Coordination: Communicate with clients and external vendors to request creative materials, confirm content requirements, collect missing information, and provide timely updates regarding ongoing deliverables.



Payment Monitoring & Follow-Ups: Track outstanding client balances, verify payment statuses, coordinate payment-related updates, and send professional follow-ups when invoices remain unpaid.



Tracker & File Management: Maintain organized and accurate Google Sheets, production trackers, shared folders, and task records. Ensure information is updated consistently so the team has clear visibility into ongoing work.



Task Planning & Deadline Management: Monitor upcoming assignments, maintain personal task lists and calendar reminders, and ensure deliverables are completed ahead of or within their deadlines.



Slack Communication & Shift Reporting: Monitor assigned Slack channels, respond to relevant requests, coordinate communications, and prepare clear shift handoff reports for the Operations Manager.



Problem Identification & Escalation: Identify missing files, unclear instructions, broken links, and potential delays early. Communicate concerns promptly and take appropriate steps to prevent work from being delayed.



POSITION DETAILS



- Position:Operations & Media Specialist

- Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

- Working Hours: 40 hours per week

- Compensation: $4.00–$5.00 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities

- Payment: Weekly through Wise

- Work Schedule:Sunday night through Thursday night (EST)

Number of Candidates We’re Looking For: 2 (Shift A and Shift B)

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Relevant Experience

- Previous experience working with remote teams and handling recurring operational responsibilities.

- Experience communicating directly with US clients is strongly preferred.

Professional Skills

- Able to manage personal schedules, task lists, and deadlines independently.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

title: Project Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Kipkeh Media is an expanding US-based media network specializing in vlogs, local business features, promotional videos, and community-focused content.



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and resourceful Project Manager to oversee our day-to-day production operations, coordinate a remote team, and ensure projects move efficiently from planning to completion.



This role requires more than task delegation and deadline monitoring. We need someone who can take a big-picture view, stay several steps ahead, recognize potential bottlenecks, and make informed decisions to keep the entire operation organized and productive.



The right candidate is a natural planner who takes responsibility, works independently, and knows how to keep people and projects moving in the right direction.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Production & Project Coordination: Manage the complete content production cycle, covering raw material collection, editing, quality checks, approvals, and publishing. Coordinate several ongoing projects, set schedules, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are completed within agreed timelines.



Remote Team Leadership: Supervise and coordinate remote personnel, including content creators, intake specialists, and video editors. Assign responsibilities, establish clear expectations, address workflow concerns, and maintain consistent team accountability.



Strategic Planning & Execution: Stay ahead of upcoming assignments, anticipate possible delays, and identify scheduling or resource conflicts early. Organize priorities, make necessary adjustments, and take action before small issues develop into larger operational problems.



Production & Quality Control: Oversee incoming content and production progress, identify areas requiring attention, and communicate specific feedback or editing directions. Ensure the team follows established workflows, production guidelines, and quality standards.



Performance Tracking & Reporting: Keep project management sheets, production calendars, and task trackers accurate and organized. Monitor completion rates, communicate progress, flag outstanding work, and identify opportunities to improve team productivity and operational efficiency.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- At least 2 years of relevant experience in project management, operations management, or production coordination.

- Previous experience supervising remote employees and handling multiple projects at once.

- Excellent planning, organizational, and scheduling capabilities.

- A self-driven professional who anticipates what needs to be done rather than waiting for instructions.

- Strong decision-making, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to lead people, manage changing workloads, and work with minimal supervision.

- Open to constructive feedback and committed to professional development.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Comfortable working with Google Workspace, Slack, and project management platforms.

- Background in media production, content operations, or video editing workflows is an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success in this position means having a well-coordinated production operation where projects progress according to schedule, team members understand their responsibilities, and potential issues are addressed before they disrupt the workflow.



We want someone who can independently recognize the next steps, maintain operational structure, and make sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



Most importantly, we value someone who brings initiative, sound judgment, accountability, and practical solutions to the team.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



- $5.00–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and capabilities.

- Full-time position, 40 hours per week.

- Fully remote working arrangement.

- Weekly payments through Wise.

- Opportunity for professional development and career advancement as the company grows.



HOW TO APPLY



Please read and follow the application requirements below.



 Subject: Project Manager - Your Full Name



Submit ONE Google Drive or iCloud link(with sharing permissions set to "Anyone with the link can view") containing the following:



1. Updated Resume/CV outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

2. Screenshot of your computer specifications (16GB RAM or higher preferred).

3. Screenshots of your primary and backup internet speed test results.

4. A photo of your dedicated home office or workstation.

5. Evidence of your backup power arrangement (UPS, power station, generator, or solar system).



We are looking for someone dependable, organized, forward-thinking, and comfortable taking responsibility for keeping a growing production team running efficiently.

If you have the experience, initiative, and leadership approach we're looking for, we would be glad to hear from you. Please ensure that your application includes all the requested information and follows the submission instructions above.

title: CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME
description:
CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME



Brand: Women’s Jewelry

Pay: $2,000/month base + performance bonuses, up to $4,000/month total

Commitment: 40 hours per week, exclusive to our brand



THE ROLE



We’re looking for a creative, versatile video editor with advanced AI production skills and a strong understanding of direct-response advertising.



You’ll work to create short-form Meta and TikTok ads using custom footage, AI-generated content, or both. Your work should capture attention, communicate our products’ value, and drive purchases.



Formats include AI podcast ads, realistic AI UGC, street interviews, song ads, Pixar-style animation, product demonstrations, and hybrid edits.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Relevant experience: At least 2 years editing e-commerce video ads for Meta and TikTok, supported by a strong portfolio.



• Advanced AI skills: Hands-on proficiency with Higgsfield or comparable platforms, including generating and refining video, images, voices, music, and lip sync.



• Creative range: Ability to produce different editing styles and turn briefs into complete ads, including generating assets from scratch.



• Direct-response knowledge: Strong hooks, clear benefits, effective pacing, readable captions, sound design, and compelling CTAs.



• Efficient execution: Ability to apply strategist feedback, meet deadlines, and quickly produce meaningful variations based on performance insights.



• Technical proficiency: Strong skills in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software. CapCut proficiency is a major plus.



• Attention to detail: Natural-looking AI outputs, accurate jewelry designs and gold tones, error-free text, and correct aspect ratios and safe zones.



• Accountability: Clear English communication, organized project files, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of quality.



OUR CUSTOM FOOTAGE LIBRARY



We have an extensive library of original, custom footage. You must familiarize yourself with it quickly, select the strongest scenes for each concept, and creatively combine clips into engaging ads that convert.



Repeatedly recycling the same handful of clips while relevant footage goes unused makes a lack of preparation apparent. Editors who consistently fail to explore and use our assets effectively will not continue in the role.



WORKING EXPECTATIONS AND TOOLS



• Exclusive commitment: No other jobs, freelance clients, or agency commitments. Individual applicants only; outsourcing is not permitted.



• Hubstaff: All hours worked must be tracked, with work activity monitoring enabled.



• U.S. working-hour overlap: Will be discussed once hired.



• AI subscriptions: All subscriptions needed for the role will be provided.



COMPENSATION AND BONUSES



Base salary: $2,000/month.



Bonuses are available for up to two qualifying winning ads per month. Each qualifying ad must have at least $10,000 in ad spend and at least 14 days active.



Bonus per qualifying ad:



• 2.00–2.49 ROAS: $500

• 2.50–2.99 ROAS: $750

• 3.00+ ROAS: $1,000



Maximum monthly bonus: $2,000.

Maximum total monthly compensation: $4,000.



HOW TO APPLY



You MUST use a minimum of 10 Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than 10 Apply Points will not be reviewed or considered.



Include all of the following:



1) Your resume/CV and portfolio: Direct links to your strongest e-commerce ads for Meta or TikTok.



2) Two AI ad examples in different formats: Include one realistic human-led ad, such as UGC, a podcast, or a street interview, and one different format, such as animation or a song ad. For each, explain your contribution, tools used, and approximate production time.



3) Your workflow: Explain how you create a 15–45-second ad from a brief, including projects without usable source footage, and how you handle feedback and rapid iterations.



4) Your toolkit: List your editing and AI software, describe your Higgsfield and CapCut experience, and explain your preferred AI tools and why.



5) Your availability and confirmations: State your earliest start date and confirm your commitment to 40 exclusive hours per week, Hubstaff tracking and monitoring, and an unpaid practical editing exercise using footage provided.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to walk us through one portfolio project. Applications must include the requested materials and confirmations to be considered.

title: Operations Execution
description:
Operations Execution Lead

Compensation: $2,400/month



Mission

Turn priorities into finished results.



SteelSafe operates self-storage properties across the United States. There is always work that needs to get done: property issues, vendors, purchases, projects, recurring operations, and problems that cross multiple people or systems.



Your job is to own that execution.



Some work you will do yourself. Some you will delegate to team members, boots on the ground, or vendors.



Either way, you own the result.



When leadership hands you an outcome, we should be able to forget about it until you come back with the finished result.





Operating Rules

Own the result. Do not pass problems.

Assigning is not completing. Delegated work is still your responsibility.

Asana is the system of record. If it is not in Asana, it does not exist.

No proof = not done.

Move fast. Small problems get expensive when they sit.

No silent failures. Surface risks early with a recovery plan.

Bring solutions. If leadership must d
, bring the options and your recommendation.

Close loops. Nobody should have to ask, “Whatever happened with that?”

Build better systems. The better you get, the less time the same work should require.



What You Own



1. Property & Rent-Ready Execution



Drive property work from problem to verified completion.



Examples:

Get unavailable units back to Rent-Ready.

Coordinate cleanouts.

Get doors, locks, leaks, roofs, gates, cameras, fencing, weeds, trash, signs, electrical issues, and other property problems resolved.

Coordinate vendors, quotes, scheduling, execution, and proof.



The process is: Problem → Owner → Quote → Approval if needed → Schedule → Execute → Verify → Close



Every unavailable unit must have a reason, owner, next action, and deadline.



Do not report that a unit is stuck.



Get it unstuck.



2. BOTG & Vendor Management



Own the people who execute work locally.

Find and hire BOTG and vendors.

Give clear scopes and deadlines.

Get quotes.

Follow up.

Verify work.

Correct poor work.

Replace underperformers.

Maintain backup options.



“I asked them” is not a result.



The work being completed correctly is the result.



3. Projects & Procurement

Own independent projects from idea to completion.



Examples include:

Source and purchase supplies or equipment.

Order signs, locks, parts, cameras, and materials.

Research and negotiate vendors or services.

Sell unused assets.

Coordinate property improvement projects.

Build new operational processes.

Complete one-off projects leadership assigns.



You are expected to figure out the path forward without needing step-by-step direction.



4. Operational Problem Resolution

When a customer or company issue requires operational action, own the execution.

Investigate the problem, determine what needs to happen, coordinate the people involved, and drive it through resolution.

Leadership owns unusual policy, legal, financial, or strategic decisions.

Once the decision is made, you own getting it done.



What Winning Looks Like

Work gets completed on time.

Projects do not stall.

Rent-Ready units do not sit because nobody followed through.

Vendors and BOTG are held accountable.

Problems are surfaced before deadlines are missed.

Completed work is actually complete.

Asana reflects reality.

Recurring work becomes simpler and requires less manual effort.



This Role Is a Fit If You

Are a doer.

Take ownership without reminders.

Finish what you start.

Can manage a small team and still execute personally.

Can take an unfamiliar project and figure it out.

Follow up relentlessly.

Make good decisions independently.

Keep many moving pieces organized.

Communicate problems early.

Hold vendors and teammates accountable.

Care about details and proof.

Enjoy turning messy work into reliable systems.



Own the result, not the clock. Do what it takes to get the job done. Then improve the system so the same result takes less time and effort next time.



How to Apply

Please submit:

-Your current resume.

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.

Website: 



Are you already exceptional at sales, customer communication, CRM management, and building relationships? Do you consistently produce results, identify opportunities, and take initiative without needing constant direction?



We're hiring an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to convert inquiries into paying customers, improve sales follow-up, build referral partnerships, and drive business growth.



IMPORTANT: This is NOT a technical digital marketing role. You don't need experience managing Google Ads,
 Ads, websites, or advanced CRM automations. Other specialists handle those responsibilities.



We want someone who excels at connecting with people, closing sales, managing customer relationships, and executing practical marketing and outreach strategies.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We're looking for an A player with proven skills, strong judgment, and a history of measurable results. 



We provide the tools, resources, and goals. You bring the expertise, initiative, and ability to execute.





About Boarding & Beyond:

Founded in 1996, Boarding & Beyond has spent 30 years making a difference in the lives of dogs and the families who love them. Located in Aurora, Colorado, USA, we provide dog daycare, boarding, and grooming services.  Our mission is simple: Change dogs' lives for the better while giving pet parents peace of mind. 



We believe exceptional businesses are built by exceptional people. Our culture values customer service, ownership, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.  We're looking for a highly capable professional who wants to make a meaningful contribution to our continued growth.



Your Mission: Generate More Paying Customers



Your primary responsibility will be to help Boarding & Beyond acquire new customers, convert more inquiries into bookings, and increase repeat business.



We already receive inquiries from dog owners interested in our services. Your first priority will be making sure those opportunities turn into paying customers.



Beyond sales conversion, you'll take ownership of customer follow-up, CRM execution, referral generation, local business outreach, and organic marketing initiatives.



You'll be responsible for executing proven strategies, identifying improvements, and producing measurable results.



Your Key Responsibilities



1. Sales & Lead Conversion — Your #1 Priority



- Personally call, text, and
 prospective customers to convert inquiries into bookings.

- Proactively follow up with leads who haven't booked.

- Build rapport, establish trust, handle objections, and close sales.

- Identify missed sales opportunities and recover potential customers.

- Improve sales scripts, follow-up strategies, and booking conversion rates.

- Track leads, sales activity, and conversion performance.

- Take ownership of ensuring qualified opportunities don't get overlooked.



We're looking for someone who is already confident, persuasive, and effective at selling over the phone.



2. CRM Management & Sales Optimization



You'll use GoHighLevel to manage leads, customer communication, follow-up, and sales opportunities.



- Keep CRM records organized, accurate, and actionable.

- Manage sales pipelines and ensure timely follow-up.

- Review recorded customer calls to identify missed sales opportunities and customer service issues.

- Recommend and implement improvements that increase conversions.

- Execute customer follow-up and reactivation campaigns.

- Identify inefficiencies and improve existing CRM processes.

- Monitor and report performance.



We want someone who understands how to use a CRM to generate revenue—not someone who simply enters data.



3. Community Outreach & Referral Partnerships



- Proactively contact veterinarians, apartment communities, pet stores, and other local businesses.

- Develop relationships that generate new customer referrals.

- Confidently make outbound calls, present partnership opportunities, and handle objections.

- Create consistent follow-up processes for potential partners.

- Develop and execute customer referral programs.

- Track which partnerships and campaigns generate paying customers.



You should already be comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and creating new business opportunities.



4. Customer Retention & Reactivation



- Reengage inactive customers and encourage repeat bookings.

- Execute targeted
 and SMS campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to increase customer retention.

- Encourage and track customer referrals.

- Improve communication throughout the customer experience.

- Measure campaign results and continuously improve performance.



5. Marketing & Online Community Engagement



- Promote Boarding & Beyond in relevant local
 groups and online communities.

- Identify opportunities to reach local dog owners.

- Create and schedule social media posts using photos and videos we provide.

- Encourage authentic customer reviews and monitor online reputation.

- Execute organic marketing campaigns that generate inquiries and bookings.

- Identify, test, and improve customer acquisition strategies.



Paid advertising, website development, and advanced technical CRM development are handled separately.



Your focus is execution that produces customers and revenue—not marketing activity for its own sake.





Who We're Looking For



We want an experienced, highly capable professional with a demonstrated history of success.



You Must Already Be Strong In:



Sales & Closing

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident, persuasive phone communication with U.S. customers.

- Strong lead follow-up and objection-handling skills.

- A demonstrated ability to convert inquiries into paying customers.

- The ability to independently manage sales conversations from initial contact through booking.



CRM & Customer Relationship Management

- Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-up using CRM software.

- Understanding of how to improve sales conversion through effective follow-up.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to recognize sales process problems and recommend practical solutions.



Marketing & Business Development

- Experience executing marketing or customer acquisition initiatives.

- Ability to research prospects, conduct outreach, and develop relationships.

- Understanding of referrals, retention, and customer engagement.

- Ability to measure performance and improve results.



Independent Execution & Ownership

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

- Ability to prioritize high-impact work without constant supervision.

- Initiative to identify and solve problems independently.

- A track record of reliably completing commitments.

- A genuine desire to improve performance and contribute ideas.





We care far more about demonstrated performance than degrees, certifications, or impressive-sounding job titles.



You don't need to know the pet care industry. But you should already be highly competent in the core sales, communication, CRM, and marketing skills this position requires.





How We Operate



We give our team clear goals, tools, and the opportunity to take ownership. In return, we expect professionalism, accountability, and excellent execution.



Our operating principles are:



- Customer First: Every interaction should create value and build trust.

- Results Over Activity: We measure outcomes, not how busy you are.

- Own the Outcome: Take initiative, solve problems, and follow through.

- Focus on What Matters: Prioritize the work that generates the greatest impact.

- Raise the Standard: Deliver excellent work and continuously improve.

- Move Fast: Execute, measure, learn, and improve.

- Zero Silent Failures: Communicate problems early and bring a recovery plan.

- No Proof = Not Done: Use Asana to document commitments, deadlines, completed work, and results.

- Build Better Systems: Improve processes instead of repeatedly working around problems.



We don't believe great people need to be micromanaged. We believe they need clear expectations, the right tools, and the opportunity to perform.



How Success Is Measured



You'll have a written performance scorecard with clearly defined goals.



Success includes:



- Higher percentages of qualified inquiries converted into paying customers.

- More customers generated through follow-up and reactivation.

- More paying customers from referrals and local partnerships.

- Improved customer retention and repeat bookings.

- Better customer service and sales call quality.

- Accurate CRM management and consistent follow-through.

- Successful execution of marketing initiatives that generate measurable business results.



Your results—not simply your activity—will determine your performance.



Compensation: Exceptional Results Deserve Exceptional Rewards



We believe talented people who create meaningful business results should have the opportunity to earn more.



Monthly Compensation (USD)

- Guaranteed Base Salary: $1,000/month

- On-Target Earnings: $3,000/month total

- Exceptional Performance: Up to $4,000/month total



Performance bonuses are based on agreed-upon, measurable business results. Specific goals, bonus calculations, and eligibility will be established in a written performance scorecard. Bonus earnings are not guaranteed.



Produce more value. Earn more.





How to Apply  

Please submit:

-One example of something you personally accomplished in a previous position, including measurable results.  



We care more about demonstrated performance, initiative, and results than degrees or certifications.
