title: Virtual Events & Customer Support Assistant (Eventbrite + OpenTable + Email Management)
description:
# Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist (Remote)



**Eventbrite | POSH | Luma | Customer Service |
 & Phone Support | Administrative Operations**



**Company:** DMV Events / Konnex Events  

**Location:** 100% Remote – International Applicants Welcome  

**Position:** Part-Time Initially, With Full-Time Growth Opportunity  

**Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Washington, D.C. Time (Eastern Time)  

**Compensation:** $2–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience, qualifications, location, and applicable employment laws  

**Start Date:** Immediate



## About Our Company



We are a fast-growing, U.S.-based events, entertainment, and technology company headquartered in the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.



Our company organizes singles mixers, speed dating events, nightlife experiences, bar crawls, networking events, social gatherings, and special events at restaurants, lounges, and nightclubs.



We work with multiple venues, entertainment partners, promoters, and customers across Washington, D.C., Northern Virginia, Maryland, and expanding U.S. markets.



We currently manage **100+ active event listings** and utilize multiple online platforms to coordinate ticket sales, registrations, customer communication, event marketing, and business operations.



As our company continues expanding, we are looking for a **highly organized, dependable, intelligent, and proactive Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist** to help manage the daily operations of our business.



**This is much more than a traditional Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who can eventually become a trusted member of our operations team, independently handle customer inquiries, manage event listings, communicate with business partners, and keep our company running smoothly.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people, learns software quickly, and can manage multiple assignments simultaneously.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Customer Service & Virtual Support



You will serve as one of the primary points of contact for our customers.



- Monitor and respond to incoming customer
s throughout your assigned shifts.

- Answer questions regarding upcoming events, tickets, venues, schedules, and registration.

- Provide excellent customer support through
, online messaging, live chat, and telephone.

- Handle ticket-related questions, cancellations, refund requests, and registration issues according to company policies.

- Respond professionally to customer complaints and resolve problems efficiently.

- Follow up with customers to ensure their questions are answered and issues are resolved.

- Help attendees understand event locations, arrival instructions, and check-in procedures.

- Escalate urgent or sensitive customer matters to management.

- Maintain a friendly, welcoming, professional customer experience.



**Excellent spoken and written English is essential for this position.**



### 2. Eventbrite, POSH & Luma Event Management



You will help manage our online event listings and registration platforms.



Platforms include:



- Eventbrite

- POSH

- Luma

- Other event registration and ticketing platforms



Responsibilities include:



- Create new events on multiple platforms.

- Duplicate and schedule recurring weekly events.

- Write, edit, and improve event descriptions.

- Upload event flyers, promotional images, and information.

- Update ticket pricing, registration limits, and event details.

- Ensure addresses, event times, venue names, and dates are accurate.

- Monitor event registrations and ticket sales.

- Review existing listings for mistakes, outdated information, or broken links.

- Maintain consistency across all ticketing platforms.

- Assist with registration lists and attendee check-in reports.

- Track upcoming events and confirm listings are published on time.



You must be comfortable managing **100+ active event listings** while maintaining accuracy and organization.



### 3.
, Telephone & Business Communication



This position requires excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with customers and business partners.



- Monitor and organize company
 inboxes.

- Respond promptly and professionally to incoming messages.

- Make and receive business telephone calls when required.

- Communicate with customers, restaurants, nightclubs, event organizers, DJs, and venue management.

- Confirm event schedules and coordinate logistical details with partner venues.

- Send reminders, confirmations, and follow-up messages.

- Draft professional business
s.

- Communicate updates between customers, partners, and company management.

- Maintain organized records of important conversations and follow-up tasks.



**You must be confident speaking English on the telephone with U.S.-based customers and business professionals.**



### 4. Venue Reservations & Partner Coordination



You will assist our operations team with coordinating weekly events across multiple restaurants, lounges, and entertainment venues.



- Use OpenTable and other reservation systems to make and manage reservations.

- Confirm reservations and event arrangements with venues.

- Coordinate arrival times, table sizes, and expected attendance.

- Maintain updated contact information for venue managers and partners.

- Confirm that participating venues have accurate event information.

- Assist with last-minute event changes and schedule adjustments.

- Maintain professional relationships with venue staff and partners.

- Track confirmations, outstanding requests, and unresolved issues.



### 5. Administrative Operations & Multitasking



You will help keep the company's daily operations running smoothly.



- Manage multiple assignments and platforms simultaneously.

- Maintain organized calendars, schedules, and spreadsheets.

- Update Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and internal tracking systems.

- Track ticket sales, registrations, customer support requests, and attendance.

- Prepare basic daily and weekly activity reports.

- Keep digital files, folders, and event records organized.

- Identify missing information, incorrect listings, and operational issues.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks without constant reminders.

- Prioritize urgent customer support requests while completing administrative work.

- Provide management with regular updates on completed assignments and outstanding issues.



**You must be someone who can independently manage a busy workflow without becoming overwhelmed.**



### 6. Marketing, CRM & Customer Follow-Ups



You may also assist our team with basic marketing and customer engagement activities.



- Help coordinate
 and SMS campaigns for customers who have opted in to receive communications.

- Prepare event reminders and follow-up communications.

- Maintain customer and attendee databases.

- Assist with CRM updates and customer segmentation.

- Help coordinate promotional campaigns across different event platforms.

- Schedule basic social media posts.

- Support customer retention and repeat attendance initiatives.

- Work with management on improving customer satisfaction and event participation.



### 7. Special Projects & Business Growth



As our company grows, you may also support additional projects involving:



- Onboarding new event venues and organizers.

- Expanding events into additional U.S. cities.

- Helping organize new customer service processes.

- Supporting new software platforms and event technology.

- Improving internal workflows and operations.

- Assisting with partner communications and new business opportunities.



We value employees who contribute ideas, identify inefficiencies, and help us improve our operations.



## Required Qualifications



**Communication Skills**



- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Clear, professional speaking voice.

- Confidence handling telephone calls with U.S. customers and business partners.

- Ability to write professional
s independently.

- Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

- Ability to communicate calmly and professionally when resolving problems.



**Computer & Technical Skills**



- Excellent general computer and internet skills.

- Ability to quickly learn new software platforms.

- Comfortable working with multiple browser tabs and applications.

- Familiarity with Gmail or similar
 platforms.

- Experience with Google Workspace, Google Sheets, or Microsoft Excel.

- Good typing speed and attention to detail.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic software and account issues.



**Organization & Work Ethic**



- Excellent multitasking abilities.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Highly dependable, punctual, and responsive.

- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

- Comfortable working independently.

- Ability to follow written instructions and standard operating procedures.

- Willingness to learn and accept constructive feedback.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.



**Equipment & Availability**



- Reliable computer or laptop.

- Stable high-speed internet connection.

- Working microphone or headset for customer calls.

- Quiet, professional environment for telephone conversations.

- Consistent availability during assigned shifts within 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

- Ability to attend occasional meetings or support special event schedules with advance notice.



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience in the following areas is a major advantage:



- Virtual Assistant or Executive Assistant

- Customer Support Representative

- Administrative Assistant

- Event Coordinator or Event Management

- Eventbrite event management

- POSH or Luma event creation

- OpenTable or restaurant reservation systems

- Call center or telephone customer service

- Hotel, hospitality, restaurant, or nightlife operations

-
 and SMS marketing

- CRM or customer database management

- Canva or basic graphic design

- Social media management



**Previous Eventbrite experience is strongly preferred, but we will consider candidates with excellent communication skills, administrative experience, and the ability to learn quickly.**



## Work Schedule



**Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Washington, D.C. Time (Eastern Time)**



We are initially hiring for a part-time role, with scheduled working hours falling within this window.



Qualified candidates must have reliable availability during their assigned hours.



As responsibilities expand, the position may transition into a full-time role covering the complete business day.



Some additional flexibility may be requested during busy event weeks or special occasions.



## Compensation & Career Growth



**Starting Compensation: $2–$5 USD per hour**, based on relevant experience, communication ability, location, and applicable employment laws.



We offer:



- Long-term employment opportunities.

- Flexible growth from part-time to full-time.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Opportunities for increased responsibilities and compensation.

- Exposure to U.S. event management and hospitality operations.

- Training on different software platforms.

- Potential advancement into a supervisory or operations management role.



**Career Growth Opportunity:**



Virtual Events Operations & Customer Support Specialist → Senior Operations Assistant → Events Operations Manager



We want to invest in someone who can grow with our company over the long term.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role?



We are looking for someone who:



- Takes initiative instead of waiting for instructions.

- Notices and corrects mistakes before they become problems.

- Responds quickly and follows through on commitments.

- Enjoys helping customers and solving problems.

- Can communicate confidently with venue owners and business partners.

- Learns new software and processes quickly.

- Can independently manage several different systems.

- Stays organized even when handling multiple assignments.

- Takes ownership of their responsibilities.

- Wants to become an important part of a growing company.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assignments mechanically. We want someone who thinks ahead, understands our business, and helps us operate more efficiently.



## Please Do Not Apply If:



- You cannot consistently work your assigned Eastern Time schedule.

- You are uncomfortable speaking English on the telephone.

- You frequently miss deadlines or require constant reminders.

- You are unable to multitask or manage competing priorities.

- You cannot respond to customers promptly during scheduled working hours.

- You do not have reliable internet access.

- You cannot dedicate sufficient attention to this role.

- You are not interested in learning new software or processes.



We are looking for someone **reliable, professional, detail-oriented, and committed to long-term growth**.



## How to Apply



To demonstrate that you have carefully read this job posting, **start your application with the words: "DMV Events Pro."**



Please include the following:



1. **Resume:** Attach your most recent resume or CV.

2. **Customer Support Experience:** Describe your previous experience handling customer
s, chat messages, and telephone calls.

3. **Event Platform Experience:** Tell us whether you have used Eventbrite, POSH, Luma, OpenTable, or similar platforms.

4. **English Communication:** Provide a short 45–60 second voice introduction explaining your background and why you are interested in this position.

5. **Computer & Internet:** Tell us what type of computer you use and your internet speed.

6. **Availability:** Confirm that you can work during assigned shifts between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Washington, D.C. time, Monday through Friday.

7. **Hourly Rate:** State your expected hourly compensation in USD.

8. **Why Should We Hire You?** Explain what makes you a strong candidate and how you would help our company.



**We are interviewing immediately and aim to make hiring decisions within 48 hours of completing the interview process.**



If you are highly organized, excellent with customers, confident using technology, and excited to grow with a fast-moving U.S. events and entertainment company, we encourage you to apply.



**Join our team and help us build one of the fastest-growing event communities in the Washington, D.C. area and beyond.**

- TypeScript, Next.js 14 (App Router), React

- PostgreSQL with Prisma

- NextAuth (Google sign-in)

- Tailwind CSS

- Vitest for testing

- Vercel hosting, GitHub pull requests and CI



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build features from detailed designs, matching them closely — clean, minimal UI that works on desktop and mobile

- Design database changes and write the server logic, permissions and tests behind each feature

- Build the integration between this platform and our existing photography platform (syncing data reliably between two systems, handling retries and failures)

- Work in small pull requests, each with tests, a clear description and screenshots

- Keep project docs and AI instructions up to date as decisions change



MUST HAVE

- 3+ years of professional TypeScript/JavaScript development

- Production experience with Next.js and React (App Router a plus)

- Strong PostgreSQL and schema design; Prisma or a similar ORM

- Writes automated tests as a habit

Creative Strategists provide final READY TO EDIT briefs. title: Dispositions Coordinator (Remote)
description:
To Apply (Important):



Send a voice recording answering the following questions:



-Why do you think you’re a great fit for the dispositions coordinator role?

-Describe your experience with coordinating transactions, dealing with real estate investors, or making outbound calls.

-Are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. business hours?

-What CRMs have you worked with before?

Applications without a video OR voice recording will not be considered!



Why Joe Homebuyer



At Joe Homebuyer, we help homeowners who need a simpler, more flexible way to sell — and we move fast for the investors who buy from us. This is the engine seat behind our dispositions: you keep every deal moving from contract to close.

Our culture is built around four values:

Humble: Stay coachable, own mistakes, and improve.

Hungry: Pursue results and take initiative.

Integrity: Do the right thing, even when no one’s watching.

Take Ownership: Own the outcome — no excuses, no blame.



The Opportunity

We’re hiring a remote Dispositions Coordinator to run the back end of our buyer and closing process. You are the connective tissue between our Dispositions Manager, our buyers, our sellers, and our Transaction Coordinator. In-person walkthroughs and field work stay with the Dispositions Manager — your job is to make sure every one of those is teed up, every buyer is qualified, every contract is out, and nothing slips.

If you’re organized, a clear phone communicator, and you get satisfaction from a clean pipeline, this is your seat.



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30am–5:30pm EST

Full time hours

Compensation: $7/hr + $100 per closed deal

Responsibilities

Call buyers ahead of every walkthrough to schedule and confirm attendance

Call sellers to confirm walkthrough date, time, and access

Send contracts to buyers and confirm receipt/signature

Verify buyer funding — confirm lender or proof of funds before we commit

Coordinate with the Transaction Coordinator on title issues until cleared

Run comps to support the Dispositions Manager’s pricing

Build and send
 marketing and text blasts for each new deal

Add new buyers to the buyers list every week and keep it growing

Log all notes and contracts in Salesforce — accurately and same-day

Report dispo metrics on the daily tracker

Flag missing information immediately — ask, don’t assume

Standard: Every active deal has a confirmed walkthrough, a verified buyer, a sent contract, and current Salesforce notes. If it’s not in Salesforce, it didn’t happen.

Key Performance Indicators & Scorecard



Dispositions & Buyer Development

10 buyer attendees at each property walkthrough

20 new cash buyers added to the buyer list each week

75% assignment / close success rate on deals taken under contract

Contract cancellation rate under 30%

Average assignment over $20,000

100% of notes, buyer activity, and pipeline status in CRM same day (Salesforce)



Who This IS For

Detail-obsessed, proactive, and coachable. A confident phone communicator who follows up relentlessly, keeps clean records, and speaks up the moment something’s missing.

Who This Is NOT For

People who need hand-holding, let contracts or follow-ups sit, guess instead of asking, or treat data entry as optional.

Requirements

2+ years in a coordination, sales-support, or VA role with a documented track record

Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable making outbound calls to US buyers and sellers

CRM discipline (Salesforce experience a strong plus)

Reliable high-speed internet, quiet call environment, and a working headset

Availability Monday–Friday, 8:30am–5:30pm EST

Real estate/dispositions experience helpful, not required — we’ll teach the deal side to the right communicator



Compensation & Milestones

$7/hour + $100 per closed deal.



Hourly rate and closed deal bonus will be evaluated on a biannual basis and can be increased based on performance.



Success Roadmap

Week 1: Learn — Meet the team, learn our process, tool and Salesforce setup.

Week 2: Shadow — Listen to buyer/seller calls, learn scripts, start logging deals.

Week 3: Run Support — Independently confirm walkthroughs, send contracts, verify funding under review.

Week 4: Own It — Full ownership of buyer outreach, marketing blasts, tracker, and Salesforce.

30 Days: Running daily buyer/seller confirmations and Salesforce entry solo

60 Days: Owning marketing blasts and buyer-list growth

90 Days: Full standard — every deal coordinated end-to-end with zero dropped follow-ups

Learn it. Prove it. Repeat it. Own it.

title: Cold Caller for US Supplement Brands ($2/hr Base + 20% of Every Sale + Monthly Residuals)
description:
About Solva

Solva is a small, new studio. Every week we take the Instagram Reel formats that are trending and remake them with a brand's product, using AI video tools. A person directs and edits every video. We sell to US supplement and wellness brands that already run Meta ads. You'd be our first caller.



The job

- Call US supplement brands that we've already
ed.

- Reach the founder or the person who runs marketing, and offer 3 free videos for their product.

- When a brand wants ads or more videos, walk them to the checkout on our site while you're on the call.

- Follow a written script word for word, and log every call in a Google Sheet.



Schedule

Your choice of hours, at least 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, between 10:00 PM and 9:00 AM Philippine time. That's US business hours: you call the East Coast first and the West Coast last.



Pay (base + commission)

To be upfront: we're new, so the base is small and most of what you earn comes from commission. You keep a big share of every sale.

- A base of $2 per hour from your first shift, for the calling hours shown in your call log (up to 20 hours a week). It goes up to $3 per hour after your first 3 paid sales.

- 20% of every payment from a brand you brought in:

  - $100 for each $500 package ($150 once it's $750 from December 1)

  - $20 for each $100 single video

  - $280 for the first month of our $1,400 monthly plan

- 10% of every later month of the $1,400 plan ($140 a month), for up to 6 months while the brand stays.

- $3 for every brand that says yes to the 3 free videos, once we deliver them. These add up and are paid out with your first sale commission.

- A sale is yours when the brand pays within 30 days of a call you logged.

- Paid every Friday by Wise or PayPal, with a statement: the base for the week before, and commission once a payment has cleared and 14 days have passed with no refund.



What you get from us

- A US calling number.

- A daily list of brands we've already
ed.

- A written script and answers to common questions.

- If you already have your own US calling setup, you earn 25% instead of 20%.



You need

- Excellent spoken English that sounds natural on the phone.

- At least 1 year of cold calling or appointment setting for US companies.

- A quiet room, a headset, stable internet and a backup connection.

- Comfort with Google Sheets.

- The discipline to follow a script and never promise something that isn't in it.



Nice to have: experience calling ecommerce, Shopify or Instagram-based brands.



How to apply

1. Start your application with the word REELS.

2. Include a 60 to 90 second voice recording (Vocaroo or Google Drive link) where you:

   a) read this line: "Hi Jamie, this is [your name] from Solva. Sebastian from our team
ed you yesterday about 3 free videos for your greens powder. Do you have 30 seconds?"

   b) answer, in your own words, a founder who says: "We already have an agency."

3. In one or two sentences, tell us your best cold calling result, with numbers.

- Call past customers for their yearly chimney sweep and inspection.

- Ask finished customers for a Google review.



*Lead research and outreach*

- Build lists of recently sold older homes from public property records for our mail and door hanger campaigns.

- Build commercial lists of churches, property managers, HOAs, apartment buildings, and restaurants with wood-fired ovens.

-
 real estate agents, home inspectors, HVAC companies, and roofers who can refer jobs to us.

- Check government bid websites once a week for masonry and chimney jobs.

 work can be done on your own schedule.

This is a production role. You will code bank and credit card feeds, reconcile accounts monthly, post payroll and loan entries, clear review flags in Xenett, and hand each client's close to your reviewer. You will not talk to clients. You will be reviewed on every close for the first 90 days and coached on what you miss.



WHAT YOU NEED

- 2+ years doing full monthly books in QuickBooks Online for US small businesses (not Xero, not QuickBooks Desktop only)

Required experience

Demonstrated success with lead generation, webinars, high-ticket education, coaching, professional services or similar offers.



Strong knowledge of current Advantage+ leads campaigns, creative testing, campaign budget optimisation, tracking and measurement.

title: Part-Time CapCut Video Ad Editor (Path to Full-Time)
description:
WHO WE ARE:

2. Clean Audio Mastering: Smooth all clip cuts with micro audio crossfades (zero clicks, pops, or harsh jumps), keep voice balanced at -14 LUFS, and enforce STRICTLY ZERO background music.

4. Multi-Format Meta Exports: Re-frame and export finished master edits cleanly across 9:16 (1080x1920), 1:1 (1080x1080), and 16:9 (1920x1080) without cutting off faces, shoes, or captions, organized neatly into Google Drive.

5. Quick Visual QA: Flag any visual glitch in raw clips and verify final exports before handover.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Fast proficiency in CapCut Desktop (Mac or Windows) and reliable fiber internet.

- Sharp ear for clean audio transitions and sharp eye for framing/cropping across aspect ratios.

========================================================

HOW TO APPLY — 15-MINUTE CAPCUT TRIAL (~20s AD):

========================================================

We do NOT read generic resumes, ChatGPT cover letters, or "contact me on WhatsApp" messages. Every reply without the completed Trial Edit link is archived automatically.



STEP 1 — Download the 3 raw 16:9 clips here:





STEP 2 — Edit following these 4 strict rules:

1. Sequence & Pacing: Stitch `Clip_01_Hook_16x9` -> `Clip_02_Body_16x9` -> `Clip_03_CTA_16x9`. Trim dead air at clip starts/ends so pacing feels warm and natural (no Gen-Z flash zooms or sound effects).

3. Captions (UK English): Clean solid white Helvetica (or clean modern sans-serif) with subtle dark shadow/outline. Manually proofread every word in UK British English & £ GBP currency (no $ signs or auto-caption typos!). Keep captions strictly OFF the shoe and OFF the speaker's face.

4. Export 3 Meta Ad Formats (1080p MP4): Re-frame cleanly from the 16:9 master so the speaker and shoe stay properly centered and zero text clips at the edges:

UK-CUT — [Your First Name]

title: Customer Operations Associate – Order Processing
description:
Department: Sales

Reports to: Customer Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Arizona time (MST, UTC−7 year-round)

Month-to-month contract

Start Date: As soon as possible





Position Summary

The Customer Operations Associate manages accurate and timely sales order processing, order adjustments, and related partial refunds, with a primary focus on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.

This role requires an experienced order processing professional who can review customer purchase orders and approved quotes, identify discrepancies, troubleshoot order changes, and verify that adjustments are accurately reflected in sales documents and customer ledger entries.

Working across Business Central, Zendesk, Zoho CRM, and Shopify, the associate coordinates with Sales, Finance, Procurement, Warehouse, and Customer Experience to keep orders moving from receipt through shipment. Success requires strong technical skills, sound judgment, clear communication, and ownership of issues through resolution.



Key Responsibilities

Sales Order Processing

• Review customer purchase orders and approved quotes for completeness, accurate pricing, item numbers, quantities, and required approvals.

• Create and maintain sales orders in Business Central, including converting approved sales quotes into orders.

• Validate customer records, billing and shipping details, payment terms, tax documentation, and delivery requirements.

• Confirm product availability, lead times, freight charges, shipping methods, Incoterms, and special handling requirements.

• Verify required prepayments or credit approvals with Finance before releasing orders.

• Resolve discrepancies between customer purchase orders, approved quotes, CRM records, and sales orders.

• Prepare and send order confirmations, pro forma invoices, and updated order documents.

• Attach or link purchase orders, quotes, tax forms, approvals, and supporting correspondence.

• Manage the order processing queue and prioritize urgent or time-sensitive orders.

Order Adjustments, Partial Cancellations & Refunds

• Process authorized quantity reductions, line cancellations, price changes, shipping adjustments, and related partial refunds.

• Determine the appropriate adjustment workflow based on order source, payment method, payment application status, and shipment status.

• Work with prepayment invoices, prepayment credit memos, sales credit memos, and Customer Ledger Entries according to established procedures.

• Review invoices, payments, credits, applied entries, and remaining balances to verify that adjustments are recorded correctly.

• Process authorized Shopify order edits and partial refunds and verify the corresponding records in Business Central.

• Troubleshoot discrepancies involving order totals, taxes, shipping charges, prepayments, credits, and refunds.

• Investigate missing, duplicated, or mismatched transactions across connected systems and coordinate corrections with the appropriate team.

• Document customer authorization, internal approvals, adjustment details, and completed actions in Zendesk and Business Central.

• Communicate revised order details and refund information clearly to customers.

Order Monitoring & Cross-Functional Coordination

• Monitor assigned orders through shipment and follow up on outstanding requirements.

• Coordinate with Sales, Finance, Procurement, and Warehouse to resolve payment holds, missing information, availability issues, and fulfillment delays.

• Maintain accurate order statuses, system notes, and customer updates.

• Escalate blocked orders and unresolved discrepancies promptly, with clear documentation of the issue and actions taken.

• Ensure handoffs include the information needed for the receiving team to act.

• Identify recurring errors and process gaps and recommend practical improvements.



Skills & Qualifications

Education

• University degree.



Required Experience & Technical Skills

• 3+ years of hands-on sales order processing or order management experience, including complex order changes, partial cancellations, and refunds.

• 2 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central required, specifically within Sales and Receivables: customer cards, sales quotes, sales orders, prepayment invoices, prepayment credit memos, sales credit memos, and Customer Ledger Entries.

• Demonstrated ability to independently process order adjustments and partial refunds, including orders with applied payments or partial shipments.

• Working knowledge of customer ledger entries and payment applications, including reviewing invoices, payments, credits, and remaining balances.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot sales order discrepancies involving pricing, discounts, taxes, shipping charges, prepayments, and order totals.

• Experience selecting the appropriate adjustment workflow based on order source, payment method, payment application status, and shipment status.

• Experience reviewing customer purchase orders against approved quotes and sales orders to verify accuracy and resolve discrepancies.

• Solid understanding of the quote-to-order and order-to-shipment process, including advance payment and credit terms orders, order release requirements, and fulfillment dependencies.

• Experience using Zendesk to manage order-related tickets, document investigations and approvals, and communicate customer updates.

• Experience using Zoho CRM, looking up deal information, changing quotes stages, and creating  PDFs of existing quotes. 

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, including XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, filtering, sorting, and comparing order data to identify discrepancies.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook.



Preferred Experience

• Hands-on Shopify order management and refund experience, including order edits, partial refunds, and investigating discrepancies between Shopify and Business Central.

• Experience verifying that order changes and refunds are accurately reflected across connected systems.

• Experience supporting U.S. and international orders, including tax exemption documentation, freight terms, and special shipping requirements.

Communication & Work Standards

• Advanced English proficiency (C1–C2 CEFR) in reading, writing, speaking, and active listening.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated record of accurate, well-documented work.

• Ability to explain order changes, payment requirements, and refund details in clear, customer-friendly language.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills to manage order volume and competing priorities.

• Sound judgment when investigating discrepancies, following approval requirements, and escalating issues.

• Reliability, accountability, and consistent follow-through until work is completed or formally handed off.

• A collaborative approach to resolving issues with customers and cross-functional teams.

title: AI VIDEO MAKER/EDITOR | FACEBOOK ADS (E-COMMERCE)
description:
We're looking for an AI video maker/editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.



We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand creating products for the health supplement niche, and paid social is one of our main growth channels. That means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.



We need someone who can help us produce high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels. This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).



This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, AI-generated creative, UGC-style ads, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative.



WHAT YOU'LL BE CREATING AND EDITING

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

- AI avatar ads: realistic avatars created from photos and animated in HeyGen, voiced with ElevenLabs on scripts we provide

- Pixar-style animated ads: fully generated creatives built with Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance)

-
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

- UGC-style ad creatives: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

- Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits showing the product in action

- Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after moments, and social proof

- VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

- Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about beautiful visuals. We want someone who understands how ads actually work.

You should know how to make videos that:

- Stop people in the first 1-3 seconds

- Make the problem feel real and urgent

- Show the product clearly and persuasively

- Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

- Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

- Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

- Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

- Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase



You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, and creative notes, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing. And when there's no footage to work with, you should be able to generate it yourself with AI.



THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE

You'll be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands

- Have hands-on experience producing creatives with AI tools, not just experimenting with them

- Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

- Can create multiple ad variations quickly

- Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

- Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

- Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

- Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

- Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good



We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You need experience with:

- HeyGen: avatar creation from photos and realistic animation

- ElevenLabs: text-to-speech and voiceover

- Higgsfield (nano banana pro, Kling, Seedance): animated and generated video

- At least 6 consecutive months of real work with these tools, not occasional use



Ideally, you also have experience with:

- Meta/Facebook ad creatives

- Short-form paid social videos

- Long-form VSLs or sales videos

- Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools



Bonus if you've worked with the health supplement niche.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY

- Creating avatars and animating them in HeyGen

- Producing voiceovers in ElevenLabs from our scripts

- Building Pixar-style animated ads with Higgsfield

- Researching and sourcing clips for VSLs

- Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, and references

- Editing with music, voiceover, sound effects, transitions, and subtitles

- Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

- Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

- Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios

- Uploading finished videos to Google Drive, clearly named and organized

- Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

- Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



WHAT YOU GET

- Competitive compensation based on experience

- The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive revenue

- Clear creative direction and fast feedback

- Long-term growth with a brand aiming to scale aggressively, for someone who wants more responsibility over time



We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert.

If you're an AI video maker/editor who understands performance creative, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cold Caller
description:
Job Position: Cold Caller

Company: Doc the House Buyer

Reports To: Tim / Management

Salary: $6.00 per hour

15-20 hrs per week

US Central Time Zone



To apply fill out the form: 



Position Overview

The Cold Caller & Lead Follow-Up Specialist is responsible for making outbound calls, following up with existing and potential real estate leads, skip tracing property owners, and converting interested property owners into scheduled appointments.

This position will handle leads from multiple sources, including direct mail campaigns, returned mail,
, expired listings, auction, vacant property lists, previous cold-calling campaigns, old leads, and other prospect databases.

The primary goal is to ensure that no potential real estate opportunity is overlooked due to a lack of follow-up or outdated contact information.



Key Responsibilities

 Cold Calling & Lead Generation

Make outbound calls to property owners from provided lead lists and databases.

Contact potential sellers to determine their interest in selling their property.

Call vacant property owners, absentee owners, distressed property owners, tired landlords, and other targeted prospects.

Introduce the company and explain its property-buying services.

Identify motivated sellers and potential real estate opportunities.

Ask qualifying questions to understand the owner's situation and willingness to sell.

Identify the property's condition, occupancy status, and potential selling timeline.

Maintain a professional, friendly, and conversational approach.

Record call outcomes and update lead statuses in the CRM or tracking spreadsheet.

Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setting

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the position.

Follow up call with all existing leads that have not yet converted into appointments.

Reconnect with owners who previously expressed interest but were not ready to sell.

Call leads who requested a callback at a later date.

Follow up with leads who did not answer during previous attempts.

Contact leads who received previous mail campaigns but have not responded.

Re-engage old or inactive leads to determine whether their situation has changed.

Confirm appointments and ensure property owners are available.

Schedule qualified appointments directly with Tim

Send appointment details and relevant lead information to the assigned person.

Follow up after appointments when additional information or communication is needed.

Skip Tracing & Contact Information Research

The caller will be responsible for locating and verifying property owners' contact information.

Perform skip tracing on leads with missing or outdated phone numbers.

Search for alternative phone numbers for property owners.

Verify whether the phone number belongs to the correct property owner.

Research updated contact information for hard-to-reach leads.

Identify possible alternative contacts when appropriate and legally permissible.

Update the lead database with verified phone numbers and contact details.

Flag disconnected, incorrect, duplicate, or invalid numbers.

Reattempt contact using newly verified information.

Maintain accurate records of skip-tracing results.

Important: The objective is to maximize contact opportunities and avoid losing potential deals because of missing or outdated contact information.

Returned Mail Management & Follow-Up

The caller will also handle leads from returned direct mail campaigns.

Responsibilities include:

Skip trace and Call the property owners using verified contact information.

Update corrected contact information in the database.

Flag leads with no valid contact information.

Coordinate with the team to update mailing records before the next campaign.

Ensure returned-mail leads are not automatically discarded without attempting alternative contact methods.

 Mail Campaign Support & Lead Follow-Up

The caller will assist in managing and following up on leads generated through direct mail campaigns.

Responsibilities include:

Contact property owners who received mail pieces.

Call leads who have not responded to the mail campaign

Record interested sellers, callbacks, refusals, and unreachable leads.

Coordinate with the team regarding updated mailing lists.

Review Returned Mail and Do Not Mail lists before making contact.

Identify potential leads for future mailing campaigns.

Maintain campaign-related call records for reporting and KPI tracking.

Old Leads & Database Reactivation

The caller should not limit their work to newly generated leads.

They must also work through the company's existing lead database.

Call old leads that were previously contacted.

Revisit leads that were marked as follow-up or not ready.

Contact leads that previously declined but may have changed their minds.

Reconnect with leads that went cold or stopped responding.



Required Skills & Qualifications

Essential skills:

Excellent spoken English and communication skills.

Strong conversational and telephone skills.

Experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

Ability to handle objections and rejection professionally.

Good listening and questioning skills.

Strong follow-up and organizational skills.

Ability to research and verify contact information.

Familiarity with skip tracing.

Basic understanding of real estate and property acquisitions.

Experience using CRMs, spreadsheets, and lead databases.

Ability to work independently and meet daily targets.



Preferred experience:

Must have good command of english without a strong accent

Real estate cold calling.

Wholesaling and property acquisitions.

Motivated seller lead generation.

Direct mail campaign follow-up.

Vacant property and absentee owner outreach.

Appointment setting for real estate investors.

title: AI Video Ads Editor For Meta Ads
description:
We're a 7-figure supplement company running meta ads at scale, and we're hiring an AI Video Editor who lives at the frontier of AI video generation. If you're already producing realistic, high-converting AI ads — and you're the kind of editor who tests every new model the week it drops — this is a role where that obsession actually gets used.



You'll own AI-generated ad creative end to end:
/Meta ads built to hold up against the best direct-response creative work out there. Your ads won't sit in a folder — they go live, against real spend, at real volume. Which means that this is a consistent, reliable long term role.



What you'll be doing:



You'll ship 10 AI-generated video concepts per week, from prompt to finished ad — building realistic AI avatars, characters, scenes, and b-roll that don't read as "AI." Day to day that means:



* Producing 10 concepts/week, each taken from initial prompt through to a polished, ready-to-run ad

* Generating realistic avatars, characters, and scenes across the modern AI video stack

* Assembling AI footage with b-roll, motion graphics, text overlays, captions, and sound design into ads built to convert

* Sourcing supporting b-roll (medical animations, stock, AI-generated scenes) as concepts require

* Studying competitor ads and winning creative across niches to fuel your ideation

* Internalizing customer messaging and building concepts around the angles that actually convert

* Re-editing winning ads — new visuals, voice, text, and hooks — to scale what's working

* Working with our Creative Strategists on briefs, revisions, and brand guidelines

* Testing new tools as they launch and folding the ones that work into your pipeline



You should already be hands-on with the modern AI video stack:



HeyGen — realistic AI avatars and spokesperson videos

Nano Banana Pro — image generation and scene creation

Higgsfield — AI motion and cinematic shots

VEO 3 — high-fidelity AI video generation

KLING 3.0 — AI video generation

ElevenLabs — AI voice generation and cloning

Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or Final Cut Pro — final assembly, polish, and compositing

This is a role for editors already operating at a high level — not for someone just picking these tools up. If you can produce AI-generated ads at the standard of the examples below, we want to see your reel: ads that look real, convert, and never read as AI slop.

 and Outlook calendar quickly

Record yourself reading the lines below (about 30 seconds) and send the link (Vocaroo or Google Drive):
